verdict.rationale: First-party docs say applications 'can receive completion updates through webhooks', and the changelog adds a webhook callback for canceled jobs, so the product itself ships job-lifecycle callbacks. The evidence does not show a failure callback, how the webhook URL is registered, or the payload, signing and retry behavior. missing for 10: explicit failure-event callback, webhook registration/configuration docs, payload schema, signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a webhook or callback fires when a job completes or fails, so nothing in my system has to poll

citations.quote: Applications create transcription jobs and can receive completion updates through webhooks.
A webhook callback when a job is canceled
